# Goal: Ship Cognitive Ledger v1.0

## Statement

Alex aims to ship a stable v1.0 release of the cognitive-ledger project by end of 2026.

## Context

The cognitive-ledger v1.0 milestone involves completing core retrieval features, improving eval coverage, and writing documentation.
This is the main personal software project goal for 2026.
Success means a tagged release that is usable by others without requiring code changes.

## Next Action

- [ ] Complete retrieval eval suite (Plan 01)
- [ ] Validate semantic retrieval modes
- [ ] Write user-facing documentation
